ticker: Google shares plunge $500B over AI search revenue disruption
Binance suffers historic $6.3B exploit within 20 minutes
BOJ maintains steady interest rates while signaling future hikes
Global oil prices rise on mounting Middle East supply concerns
Sir Patrick Stewart passes away at age 86

articles.headline: Google Value Plunges by $500 Billion on AI Search Impact
articles.brief: Alphabet shares hit a six-month low after the company revealed that its native AI search summaries are negatively impacting digital advertising revenues, spooking Wall Street investors.

articles.headline: Crypto Exchange Binance Hit by Massive $6.3 Billion Heist
articles.brief: Cryptocurrency markets were shaken after hackers reportedly stole $6.3 billion in a brazen exploit completed in just twenty minutes, raising major security concerns across the industry.

articles.headline: Gold Hits Multi-Month Low Amid Federal Reserve Rate Hike Fears
articles.brief: Gold prices tumbled to a three-and-a-half-month low, heading toward a sharp monthly loss as investors priced in aggressive monetary tightening and potential interest rate hikes by the Federal Reserve.

articles.headline: Bank of Japan Keeps Rates Steady, Signals Future Hikes
articles.brief: The Bank of Japan decided to hold benchmark interest rates steady during its latest policy meeting, while officials strongly signaled that further monetary tightening remains on the horizon.

articles.headline: Oil Heads for Monthly Gain on Middle East Supply Risks
articles.brief: Crude oil prices are on track for their fourth consecutive monthly gain following a tanker attack near the Strait of Hormuz, which exacerbated ongoing worries regarding global energy supply stability.

articles.headline: AstraZeneca Beats Quarterly Forecasts, Targets Annual Savings
articles.brief: Pharmaceutical giant AstraZeneca surpassed market expectations with its latest quarterly financial results and announced an aggressive strategy to achieve $1.5 billion in annual cost savings.

articles.headline: INDIA Bloc Postpones Delhi Public Impeachment Rally Due to Rain
articles.brief: The opposition INDIA bloc was forced to delay its planned symbolic public impeachment event targeting Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar due to inclement weather conditions in New Delhi.

articles.headline: Finance Minister Defends IDBI Bank Strategic Restructuring Process
articles.brief: Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman strongly defended the strategic restructuring and disinvestment process of IDBI Bank, dismissing opposition allegations of rigged pricing and lack of transparency.

articles.headline: Global Dockworkers Strike Across Ports Against Arms Shipments
articles.brief: Labor unions representing dockworkers at more than 100 major ports worldwide launched coordinated strikes to protest international maritime arms shipments linked to ongoing armed conflicts.

articles.headline: Evacuation Corridor Opens in Frontline Russian-Occupied Oleshky
articles.brief: Hundreds of residents began leaving the heavily devastated frontline town of Oleshky following the opening of a temporary evacuation corridor amid critical infrastructure shortages.

articles.headline: New Zealand Crushes India by 87 Runs to Snap Series Sweep
articles.brief: Powered by a record-shattering batting display from Glenn Phillips and Michael Bracewell, New Zealand posted 259/7 and comfortably defeated India by 87 runs to halt their clean sweep aspirations.

articles.headline: Supreme Court Suggests Celebrity Campaign for Cracker-Free Diwali
articles.brief: The Supreme Court recommended enlisting prominent cricketers like Virat Kohli to lead public awareness campaigns aimed at curbing air pollution ahead of the upcoming Diwali festival celebrations.

articles.headline: Rescue Operations Underway After Helicopter Crashes Near Joshimath
articles.brief: Emergency services deployed rescue teams following a tragic helicopter crash near Joshimath in Uttarakhand, with multiple passengers reported missing amid adverse weather conditions.
